Name: Haley HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Haley HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] gives Pelican Town’s favorite queen b a semi-realistic glow-up with flowing platinum blonde hair, bright blue eyes, fuller lips, longer darker lashes, and a bustier, curvier silhouette.
Includes everyday portraits and a matching beach set.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Portraiture[/b].[/*]
[*]Download and extract this portrait pack.[/*]
[*]Create a folder named
[code]Hemptress Haley[/code]inside:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][/*]
[*]Place both portrait PNGs directly inside that folder, named
[code]Haley.png[/code]and
[code]Haley_IslandSouth.png[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Talk to Haley and press [b]P[/b] while her dialogue box is open until this portrait set appears.[/*]
[/list]Your everyday portrait’s path should be:
[code]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Haley/Haley.png[/code]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Detailed, semi-realistic HD portraits.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Cool platinum blonde waves.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Bright blue eyes, full lips, and thick lashes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Twelve everyday expressions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Three matching beach expressions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Blue outfits and her signature blue pendant.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Transparent backgrounds, formatted for Portraiture.[/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999][b]Portraiture by Platonymous[/b][/url][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Install versions compatible with your game.[/color]
